`split_cents` is fixed, so no grosze go missing any more. `split_cents(100, 3)` now returns `[33, 33, 34]`. Any leftover grosze go one each to the last people in the list.

**I also changed `receipt.py`.** It had its own workaround for this bug: it added the missing grosze to the last person's share itself. Once `split_cents` was fixed, that workaround would have counted the remainder twice, so I deleted that line. One effect: when more than one grosz is left over, the extras are now spread out one each. Before, the last person got all of them.

**Tests:** I added a test for uneven splits to `test_money.py`, and it passes. Because I touched `receipt.py`, I also ran `test_receipt.py`. It's only two quick tests, and they pass too, showing receipts still come out the same. I didn't run the full suite, as you asked.

Nothing is committed yet.
